title: Blind Spiral
reference: repeat 5 { while not wall_ahead { forward } turn_right }
hints: The corridor winds inward, and every side is a different length. Counting won't fit in four slots.
A while block keeps going as long as its sensor says so. Walk while there's no wall ahead, then turn right.
repeat 5 { while not wall_ahead { forward } turn_right }

story.intro: PATCH: "The Control Room. Bots up here don't count steps, they check. Try a while block: it repeats until a sensor says stop."
